snippet.title: New [Maid Survivors : Little Angels] trailer & SteamNextFest participation
snippet.description:
Hello, Masters! This is MilkEmpire.
The Steam Next Fest 2025 Feb. edition is upcoming!

there will be a new demo update for this SNF!
this demo, we added a roguelite system called "Angel's Blessing", eternally strengthens the Maid-warriors.

Play it yourself and feel the charm of the Maid-warriors.


Please add us to your wishlist through the link below!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771600/Maid_Survivors__Little_Angels/


We're also looking forward to your valuable feedback!
Join the MilkEmpire's Discord server: discord.gg/EnDkdadgpW
